description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 11 January 2019, led by two TAG TEAMs: Greninja & Zoroark-GX, whose GX attack brings two Darkness-type Pokémon-GX from the discard pile onto the Bench, and Gardevoir & Sylveon-GX, whose GX attack can also send the opponent's whole hand back into their deck. Dedenne-GX, whose Ability discards its player's hand to draw six cards, and Venomoth-GX join them, with the Supporters Janine, Koga's Trap and Lt. Surge's Strategy. The cards are numbered to 55, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Electromagnetic Radar, Pokégear 3.0 and Aether Paradise Conservation Area. In English most of its cards came out in Unbroken Bonds in May 2019.
